study: Registered whole-triangle predictive calibration and shift challenge
unit: Independent complete simulated triangle; never individual cells or dependent public valuation folds

dgp.shock: Mean factor multiplied 1.10 at first unobserved calendar (i+k+1=8) only; variance sigma2*C unchanged, later factors stable.
dgp.shared_calendar: rho=.35 within same-calendar normal innovations before lognormal transform; each cell retains prescribed conditional mean/variance while origin independence is violated.
dgp.truth: Realized full-horizon future cumulative ultimate sum minus latest observed sum; not mean reserve and not simulated public-triangle truth.

forecast_boundary: Observed upper triangle only; no future target argument. Models persisted/hashed before evaluation draws. No method/hyperparameter/score/case selection from outcomes.
rank_rule: Exact integer ceil((n+1)*level/100); kth order statistic, inclusive ties, infinite threshold when k>n. Marginal rank coverage only under whole-triangle exchangeability.
failure_rule: X-only zero-reserve/exposure-scale map for failed Mack calibration cases; visible fallback. At evaluation, baseline failed/uncovered, calibrated methods whole-real-line/unbounded. Invalid shape/missing/negative/nonfinite/exposure blocks publication. All failures and zeros retained; no silent exclusion or redraw.
scale_rule: max(raw Mack SE, latest observed cumulative sum*1e-12) for normalized score map. Uncalibrated Mack interval uses raw SE.
all_case_scores: Failures/unbounded intervals mean infinite all-case width and score; finite means explicitly conditional with counts. Coverage denominator includes all 1024 evaluation cases.
group_diagnostics: Exposure quartiles determined by corresponding matched-scenario calibration X only; no conditional/group coverage claim.
shift_rule: Independent-lognormal calibrator transferred unchanged to all test laws; differing laws have no exchangeability guarantee. Same test draws reused, not additional trials.
scope: New random draws from previously inspected fixed synthetic laws. No new public/client outcome, real insurer calibration, capital/benefits valuation, source-vintage, external review, adoption or mastery claim. Original public and 1024-case studies immutable.
